pages.title: Fed With Soul Fire
pages.text: Scattered across the land are small shrines built around a strange altar. Toss an item into soul fire within its reach and the altar consumes it, converting it into Faith - rarer items are worth more.

The altar keeps count of what's burned through it. Feeding it stack after stack of the same cheap item quickly stops being worth the trip - its yield falls off sharply the more of one thing it's seen. What Faith is actually good for is a question for another entry.
